title: Too long when you don't have a footboard.
text: Too long when you don't have a footboard.. I guess that it's my fault that I didn't love this, I completely missed that this was for a headboard and footboard combo, and was not just the standard bed frame. That would make this "c-clamp" thing more useful, since fine adjustments may need to be made in that situation. As it stands now, I just ended up with a frame that was about a foot too long for my standard queen size mattress, and I ended up using something else. Again, my error, but wanted to point this out for the next guy who may be expecting something other than a super long rail.

product_metadata.title: Leggett and Platt Consumer Products Group Adjustable Queen Brass Fashion Bed Rails Bed Frame System with 5 Legs
features: Center support for additional strength on 5/0 and 6/10
C-clamps make assembly easy w/ infinite adjustability for a perfect fit
Headboard brackets are of heavy duty construction, riveted, & fits most headboards; available in bolt-on & hook-on styles
Adjustable glides easily adjust for variable bed heights.
description: Built with sturdy construction and a black finish, the Fashion Rail Bed Frame has 1.5” x 1.5” steel side rails, 1.25” x 1.25” cross arms and center bar for solid support, with an 83” overall length. C-clamps makes assembly easy, while providing infinite adjustability so you always get the perfect fit. The heavy-duty, oversized hook-on brackets on both ends of the side rails fit virtually all headboards and footboards (bolt-on styles also available and sold separately). Adjustable glides provide a versatile height range from 5.75” to 9.25” from floor to box spring. The boring width of this model is 58-5/16" to 59-3/4”, with an inside side rails measuring 60-1/4” wide. The Leggett & Platt Fashion Rails Bed Frame comes with a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Leggett & Platt Inc. is an industry leader in the production of adjustable bases, fashionable beds, bedding support, and top of bed textiles. By keeping a close eye on the design community and other fashion and decorating sources, Leggett & Platt stays on top of the trends and knows the right mix of finishes, innovative designs, and technology to continually provide quality crafted products at an exceptional value.
